title: RealClearDefense/Lowy Institute (5/27) — 'Why Xi Jinping Is Going to Pyongyang': 외교 의전상 평양을 2026 첫 해외방문지로 배치, 러시아 궤도 이탈 방지, 두만강·나진선봉 경제접근 확보, 핵보유국 지위 묵시적 인정 가능성
snippet: Why Xi Jinping Is Going to Pyongyang — Placing Pyongyang at the symbolic apex of Xi's 2026 travel calendar is a deliberate choice. Xi's visit would seek to open up access through the Tumen River outlet and the Rajin-Sonbong economic zone, revitalizing northeast China's economy. The 2026 visit confers implicit legitimacy on a Congress that codified nuclear weapons as a permanent national capability.
